messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@acme.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 packet + next steps from demo

Hi Alice — great to meet you and the team today. Thanks for the time walking through Acme's use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Demo recap: Redwood Dedicated looks like a fit for your latency and data isolation needs; we discussed routing policies and audit/logging features.
- Security deliverables: I've attached our SOC 2 packet and a short audit logs summary (see attachments). The packet contains our control descriptions, scope, and the auditor attestation (section 1.3 onward).
- Ask: Can you confirm who on your side will drive the security review and an expected timeline? You mentioned a 2-week window for initial review — is that still realistic?
- Next steps we recommend: security review -> legal/ procurement call -> procurement timeline and redlines. If helpful, Sean can join a 15-min call to walk through the packet and answer technical questions.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v1.2.pdf (PDF, 2.1MB); Redwood_Audit_Logs_Summary.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)
Drive copy: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SOC2Packet

Happy to jump on a call — are mornings PST best for you?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
https://redwoodinference.com

P.S. If you prefer, here's a DocuSign link for our standard NDA to speed things up: https://www.docusign.com/ACME-NDA-2026

Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 packet + next steps from demo

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the follow-up and the packet. I've started sharing with our security team (Bob is on the thread). A few quick notes from Bob's initial pass:

- We see the attestation and control descriptions. Could you point us to where you document retention windows for request/response logs and how long KV caches are persisted?
- Also would like an explicit note about any third-party subprocessors and where logs are stored regionally.

We're likely to take 1-2 weeks for an initial review. I'll confirm if legal needs to be looped in for a redline. If Sean can join a short call to cover audit logs and retention model that would be very helpful.

Thanks,
Alice
Director, Platform Security
Acme Enterprises
alice.jensen@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 packet + next steps from demo

Hi Alice — checking in to see if there are any blockers on the SOC 2 packet or the audit-log details. To answer Bob's questions quickly:

- Retention: our standard retention windows are documented in the packet (see section 2.2). Default request/response logs are retained 90 days; audit logs are retained 365 days. We can discuss custom retention via Dedicated contracts.
- Subprocessors & region: section 3 lists subprocessors. Logs are stored in the region you select for Dedicated (we support us-west-2 and eu-west-1 by default).

If it's easier, Sean and I can run a brief demo of the logging pipeline and retention settings this week — 15 minutes should be enough to address the outstanding items. Any availability on your side?

Thanks,
Marissa
